description: Get the user's passkeys (security keys). target='WALLET' (default) lists the smart-account signing keys — id, label, provider, status, masked wallet address, creation date, kind ('primary' = the key from signup, 'backup' = an extra key added later as a second Safe owner), and onchainStatus (a 'pending' backup exists but cannot sign yet). target='LOGIN' lists the email-login credentials — id, label, status, masked credential id, device, last used, and provider when it could be identified (absent means unknown, including every credential registered before Moneda recorded it). Pass the id plus the same target to set_passkey_label to rename one. This does NOT report which key the app will use for the NEXT signature: that preference is stored only on the user's own device and is not readable through any API, so never infer it from kind or ordering.

target.description: WALLET (default) = smart-account signing keys, LOGIN = email login credentials

name: get_passkeys
